candidate.selection: At held-world start posterior prior P(slot1)=0.5. Before witness, form two frozen Beta slot predictions for current public action, and emit mixture q=(1-p)*q_slot0+p*q_slot1; baseline emits original active-slot Beta. After witness, update posterior with Bernoulli likelihood of witnessed reward under the TWO PRE-UPDATE slot probabilities, then apply symmetric hazard h=1/16 to posterior for next step. Keep posterior bounded and private evaluator truth inaccessible; no tuning or hidden regime hints.
